def flatten_image(img_path):
    """Load image and return flattened pixel values"""
    img = Image.open(img_path).convert("L").resize((512, 512), Image.NEAREST)
    arr = np.array(img) / 255.0
    arr = arr.flatten()
    # Reshape to (rows*cols) order
    w, h = 512, 512
    flat_arr = arr.reshape(h, w)
    ids = []
    vals = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            ids.append(f"{img_path.split('_')[0]}_{r+1}_{c+1}")
            vals.append(flat_arr[r, c])
    return np.array(vals).reshape(-1, 1), np.array(ids)
